title: India's Infosys ties up with Anthropic, days after IT selloff
title_zh: IT 抛售几天后，印度 Infosys 与 Anthropic 合作
summary: By Sai Ishwarbharath B and Haripriya Suresh BENGALURU, Feb 17 (Reuters) - Infosys unveiled a partnership with Anthropic on Tuesday, days after investor concerns that AI tools would disrupt the
summary_zh: 作者：Sai Ishwarbharath B 和 Haripriya Suresh 班加罗尔，2 月 17 日（路透社）——Infosys 周二公布了与 Anthropic 的合作伙伴关系，几天前，投资者担心人工智能工具会扰乱人工智能工具的发展。

title: AI: Is Microsoft's growth keeping up with investor expectations?
title_zh: AI：微软的增长符合投资者的预期吗？
summary: Jefferies senior analyst Brent Thill takes a closer look at Microsoft's (MSFT) path for growth as it continues to be a key player in the AI race and how investors seem to be reacting, expecting an inflection point to materialize in the tech stock.
summary_zh: 杰富瑞 (Jefferies) 高级分析师布伦特·蒂尔 (Brent Thill) 仔细研究了微软 (MSFT) 的增长路径，因为它仍然是人工智能竞赛中的关键参与者，以及投资者似乎如何反应，预计科技股将出现拐点。

title: Stock Pickers See Their Moment to Shine in Market’s AI Freak-Out
title_zh: 选股者看到了自己在人工智能市场的疯狂浪潮中大放异彩的时刻
summary: Yes, artificial intelligence is likely to disrupt companies and put some of them out of business. When a new AI tool threatens to upset an industry, investors are simply selling the whole group.
summary_zh: 是的，人工智能很可能会颠覆企业，并导致一些企业破产。当一种新的人工智能工具有可能扰乱一个行业时，投资者只会卖掉整个行业。

title: Trending tickers: Nvidia, AMD, Antofagasta, Debenhams and IHG
summary: The latest investor updates on stocks that are trending on Tuesday.
summary_zh: 投资者对周二股票趋势的最新更新。

title: Pound drops as traders anticipate interest rate cut in March
title_zh: 交易员预计三月份降息，英镑下跌
summary: Sterling has fallen to its lowest rate since 6 February
summary_zh: 英镑汇率跌至2月6日以来的最低水平

title: UK unemployment reaches five-year high and wage growth continues to slow
title_zh: 英国失业率创五年新高 工资增长持续放缓
summary: The rate of UK unemployment rose to 5.2% in October to December, its highest point since early 2021
summary_zh: 英国10月至12月失业率升至5.2%，创2021年初以来最高点

title: Adani bets $100 billion on data centres to power India’s AI ambitions
title_zh: 阿达尼斥资 1000 亿美元建设数据中心，以推动印度的人工智能雄心
summary: Adani Enterprises said on Tuesday that it will invest $100 billion to build renewable-powered AI-ready data centres by 2035, positioning India as ‌a contender in the global AI race.
summary_zh: Adani Enterprises 周二表示，将在 2035 年之前投资 1000 亿美元建设可再生能源驱动的人工智能数据中心，使印度成为全球人工智能竞赛的竞争者。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures fall ahead of shortened week with AI disruption fears in focus
title_zh: 今日股市：道指、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货在本周缩短前下跌，人工智能颠覆担忧成为焦点
summary: Wall Street is in the middle of an AI shake-up as a tech sell-off has now extended to a wide range of industries.
summary_zh: 华尔街正处于人工智能变革之中，科技股的抛售现已蔓延到广泛的行业。

title: AI is disrupting drug discovery faster than expected
title_zh: 人工智能正在以比预期更快的速度颠覆药物发现
summary: Opening Bid Unfiltered is available on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, YouTube, or wherever you get your podcasts. If you aren’t paying attention to the companies behind a new wave of AI-driven drug development, you may end up missing out on essential investment opportunities.
summary_zh: 未过滤的公开投标可在 Apple 播客、Spotify、YouTube 或任何您获取播客的地方使用。如果您不关注新一波人工智能驱动药物开发背后的公司，您最终可能会错过重要的投资机会。
